name: A11y Announcements recording in DevTools
description: Enables the ARIA-Live and JavaScript announcements recording subpane in DevTools.

name: Accelerated 2D canvas
description: Enables the use of the GPU to perform 2d canvas rendering instead of using software rendering.

name: Actor login observation start delay
description: Controls how long the actor waits after a login action before it starts waiting for the page to stabilize. Defaults to 3s; Disabled removes the delay.

name: Actor observe page content default
description: If enabled, the actor framework will capture page content by default when requested.

name: Actor observe screenshot default
description: If enabled, the actor framework will capture screenshots by default when requested.

name: Actor page stability
description: Overrides how long the actor waits for the page to stabilize after an action: the minimum wait and the initial and subsequent paint timeouts. Each defaults to 1s.

name: Actor script tool observation start delay
description: Enables observation delay after a script tool action and controls how long the actor waits before it starts waiting for the page to stabilize. Defaults to 0ms when enabled.

name: Actor script tool skip page content
description: If enabled, script tools will explicitly vote to skip page content.

name: Actor script tool skip screenshot
description: If enabled, script tools will explicitly vote to skip screenshots.

name: Actor type tool observation start delay
description: Controls how long the actor waits after a type action before it starts waiting for the page to stabilize. Defaults to 1s; Disabled removes the delay.

name: Adjust feature reports received with WebHID
description: Enable/Disable a fix for a bug that caused feature reports to be offset by one byte when received from devices that do not use numbered reports.

name: AI Mode Omnibox Entrypoint always navigates
description: If enabled, clicking aim button in omnibox always navigates directly to google.com/aimode.

name: AI Overlay Disable Navigation Context
description: Disables sharing navigation history.

name: AI Subscription Avatar Ring follow-up
description: Shows the AI subscription avatar decorations on more surfaces. Requires #enable-ai-subscription-avatar-ring.

name: AIM 3P entrypoint
description: Enables the omnibox AI Mode entrypoint for third party search engines.

name: AIM Eligibility Component Extension
description: When enabled, registers the AIM Eligibility debugger as a component extension.

name: AIM Server Eligibility
description: Enable AIM server eligibility checks.

name: AIM Server Eligibility: Include Client Locale
description: Configures whether to include the client locale in the AIM eligibility request.

name: Align delayed wake ups at 125 Hz
description: Run most delayed tasks with a non-zero delay (including DOM Timers) on a periodic 125Hz tick, instead of as soon as their delay has passed.

name: Align PDF default print settings with HTML
description: Align the default print settings for PDFs with those for HTML, including scaling and centering.

name: Allow all sites to initiate mirroring
description: When enabled, allows all websites to request to initiate tab mirroring via Presentation API. Requires #cast-media-route-provider to also be enabled

name: Allow enabling Balanced Mode for HTTPS-First Mode.
description: Enable tri-state HTTPS-First Mode setting in chrome://settings/security.

name: Allow invalid certificates for resources loaded from localhost.
description: Allows requests to localhost over HTTPS even when an invalid certificate is presented.

name: Allow local history zero-prefix suggestions beyond NTP
description: Enables local history zero-prefix suggestions in every context in which the remote zero-prefix suggestions are enabled.

name: Allow WebRTC to adjust the input volume.
description: Allow the Audio Processing Module in WebRTC to adjust the input volume during a real-time call. Disable if microphone muting or clipping issues are observed when the browser is running and used for a real-time call. This flag is experimental and may be removed at any time.

name: Always show confirmation dialog for new search engine overrides
description: When enabled, all newly-installed search engine-overriding extensions encounter the confirmation dialog (exceptions for some extensions are removed).

name: Anonymize local IPs exposed by WebRTC.
description: Conceal local IP addresses with mDNS hostnames.

name: Antivirus telemetry for downloads
description: Enables antivirus product info to be included in Safe Browsing download pings.

name: App Menu Glow Up
description: Enables the App Menu Glow Up feature.

name: Approximate Geolocation Permission
description: Enables the approximate geolocation permission prompt.

name: Arabic-Indic Digit Input
description: Enable/Disable Arabic-Indic digit input while holding right alt or ctrl+alt on Arabic 101 keyboard layout.

name: Ask-Before-HTTP in Bundled Security Settings
description: Includes Ask-Before-HTTP (HTTPS-First Mode) in the Enhanced security bundle.

name: AudioRendererMixer Immediate Pause
description: Immediately pauses the underlying audio output stream on explicit media player pauses instead of waiting for the 10-second mixer pause delay.

name: Auto Dark Mode for Web Contents
description: Automatically render all web contents using a dark theme.

name: Auto picture in picture on window occluded
description: Allows auto picture-in-picture to trigger when the window is occluded by another window.

name: Autofill AI always show Private AI notice
description: Forces the Autofill AI Private AI notice suggestion to be shown for testing, skipping cool-off timers and impression count checks.

name: Autofill AI Google Wallet Pass Branding Updates
description: When enabled, brings Autofill AI strings and images referencing passes in Google Wallet into consistency with 2026 branding requirements.

name: Autofill AI Google Wallet private passes deep link
description: Enables Autofill AI support for deep linking to private passes from Google Wallet.

name: Autofill AI no filling icons experiment
description: If enabled, Autofill AI filling suggestions do not have an icon.

name: Autofill Ambient Autofill
description: Enables Ambient Autofill.

name: Automatic detection of WebUSB-compatible devices
description: When enabled, the user will be notified when a device which advertises support for WebUSB is connected. Disable if problems with USB devices are observed when the browser is running.

name: Automatically detach USB kernel drivers
description: Automatically detach kernel drivers when a USB interface is busy.

name: AXTree Fixing
description: When enabled, allows Chrome to dynamically fix the AXTree of sites. This is experimental and may cause breaking changes to users of assistive technology.

name: Background Resource Fetch
description: Process resource requests in a background thread inside Blink.

name: Bind cookies to their setting origin's port
description: If enabled, cookies will only be accessible by origins with the same port as the one that originally set the cookie.

name: Bind cookies to their setting origin's scheme
description: If enabled, cookies will only be accessible by origins with the same scheme as the one that originally set the cookie

name: Block Cross Partition Blob URL Fetching
description: Blocks fetching of cross-partitioned Blob URL.

name: Block Root Window Accessible Name Change Event
description: This feature prevents the firing of accessible name change events on the Root Window of MacOS applications. By blocking these events, it ensures that changes to the accessible name of Root Window do not trigger notifications to assistive technologies. This can be useful in scenarios where frequent or unnecessary name change events could lead to performance issues or unwanted behavior in assistive applications.

name: BookmarkBarPrefetch
description: If enabled, bookmarkbar can trigger prefetch

name: Bookmarks Encryption
description: Enable encryption for bookmarks

name: Border around WGC captures
description: When using WGC to capture a window or a screen, draw a border around the captured surface.

name: Browser Actuator
description: Enables the Browser Actuator service for remote browser automation.

name: Browser Actuator Internals
description: Enables the chrome://browser-actuator-internals diagnostic dashboard.

name: Browser launch metadata reporting
description: Enables the collection and reporting of browser launch-related metadata for Chrome Enterprise, including CLI switches and launch timestamp

name: Browsing History Grouping Improvements
description: Enables improvements to grouping of similar browsing history on the history page.

name: Bundled Security Settings
description: Enables new Bundled Security Settings UI on chrome://settings/security. This new UI bundles all security settings into either an enhanced or standard bundle which should simplify the security settings page and also help simplify the user's decision.

name: Bundled Security Settings Secure Dns V2
description: Enables Secure DNS V2 setting in the bundles on the chrome://settings/security page. The setting will move from the advanced section to the bundled section.

name: By Date History in Side Panel
description: If enabled, shows the 'By Date' History in Side Panel

name: Cancel file uploads on content analysis
description: Allows users to cancel file uploads while content analysis is in progress.

name: Canvas Accessibility
description: Enables canvas accessibility and allows selecting the algorithm to add text for inaccessible canvas content.

name: Capture Handle for Standalone PWAs and IWAs
description: Enables Capture Handle support for standalone PWAs and IWAs when their windows are captured.

name: Cast Mirroring Native NV12
description: If enabled, NV12 video frames will be sent to the encoder without being converted to I420 during Cast Mirroring.

name: Cast Streaming 60fps
description: Enables Cast Streaming at 60 frames per second.

name: Cast Streaming Max Video Bitrate Limit
description: Enables configuring the maximum video bitrate limit for Cast Streaming to experiment with different network quality ceilings.

name: Centralized InfoBar Framework
description: Enables the centralized desktop infobars framework.

name: Change scrolling scheduling to reduce checkerboarding
description: If enabled, scrolling that would generate blank frames will now prioritize the new content over scrolling with the intention of decreasing the amount of checkerboarded frames.

name: Chrome Dark Neutrals 26
description: When enabled, updates the neutral palette for dark mode default theme

name: Chrome Refresh Themed Realbox
description: CR23 theming will be applied in Realbox when enabled.

name: Chrome Refresh Token Binding
description: Enables binding of Chrome refresh tokens to cryptographic keys.

name: Chrome Refresh Token Binding Upgrade
description: Enables opportunistic binding of existing unbound Chrome refresh tokens and session cookies to cryptographic keys. Requires Chrome Refresh Token Binding to be enabled.

name: Chrome Web Store navigation throttle
description: When enabled, passes DM Token to the Chrome Web Store.

name: Chrome-wide echo cancellation
description: Run WebRTC capture audio processing in the audio process instead of the renderer processes, thereby cancelling echoes from more audio sources.

name: Collaboration Entreprise V2
description: Enables the collaboration feature for entreprise users within the same domain.

name: Collaboration Messaging
description: Enables the messaging framework within the collaboration feature, including features such as recent activity, dirty dots, and description action chips.

name: Collapse Extensions Submenu
description: Enables a mode where if the current profile has no extensions, the extensions submenu in the application menu is replaced by a single item, e.g. "Explore Extensions".

name: Collapse Tab Group During Drag
description: Enables programmatically collapsing tab groups while dragging vertical tabs.

name: Collect accessibility heuristic result in Canvas UKM
description: Allows collecting canvas accessibility heuristic results in the Accessibility.Canvas UKM event.

name: Compose Selection Nudge
description: Enables nudge on selection for Compose

name: Composebox Drive Context Menu Option
description: Enables Google Drive option in the Composebox context menu.

name: Composebox Drive Context Menu Option Disclaimer
description: Enables the disclaimer flow for the Google Drive option in the Composebox context menu.

name: Composebox Drive Context Menu Option Sign-in Promo
Composebox Outside Click (Realbox)
description: Clicking outside the Realbox Composebox closes the suggestions dropdown and restores page interaction while keeping the Composebox open.

name: Composebox Persistent AIM Button (Omnibox)
description: Persists the AIM button in the Omnibox Composebox.

name: Composebox Persistent AIM Button (Realbox)
description: Persists the AIM button in the Realbox Composebox.

name: Composebox Persistent AIM Button With X
description: Shows an X icon on the persistent AIM button. Only effective if the persistent AIM button is also enabled for the surface.

name: Composebox Personalized Hint Text
description: Enable Composebox Personalized Hint Text

name: Composebox Rich Image Suggestions (Omnibox)
description: Enables richer image suggestions in the Omnibox Composebox for image generation.

name: Composebox Rich Image Suggestions (Realbox)
description: Enables richer image suggestions in the Realbox Composebox for image generation.

name: Composebox uses chrome-compose client
description: Composebox will use chrome-compose client when querying suggest for unimodal typed inputs instead of chrome-omni.

name: Composebox Voice Search Coherence
description: Enables the voice search coherence (new recording animation, new metrics, new stop/submit button, no live transcription) for all the composeboxes by default. Options include cobrowsing only.

name: Composebox/Searchbox Skills (Contextual Tasks)
description: Enables skills inside the composebox/searchbox input area for Contextual Tasks.

name: Composebox/Searchbox Skills (NTP)
description: Enables skills inside the composebox/searchbox input area for NTP.

name: Composebox/Searchbox Skills (Omnibox Everywhere)
description: Enables skills inside the composebox/searchbox input area for Omnibox Everywhere.

name: Composebox/Searchbox Skills (Omnibox Popup)
description: Enables skills inside the composebox/searchbox input area for Omnibox Popup.

name: Compression dictionary transport
description: Enables compression dictionary transport.

name: Compression dictionary transport ttl
description: Enables support for the 'ttl' parameter in the 'use-as-dictionary' HTTP response header.

name: Connect to Cast devices on all IP addresses
description: Have the Media Router connect to Cast devices on all IP addresses, not just RFC1918/RFC4193 private addresses.

name: Context management in the Composebox
description: Enables an updated tab context management UI in the plus button and composebox context menu.

name: Context management in the Omnibox
description: Enables context menu and favicon coins for omnibox

name: Context Menu Animation Limiting
description: When enabled, the impressions of the context menu animation will be limited.

name: Contextual cueing
description: Enables the contextual cueing system to support showing actions.

name: Contextual cueing V2
description: Enables the contextual cueing system version 2.

name: Contextual cueing V2 multi-source
description: Enables parallel evaluation of all registered cue targets and selects the winner with UCB scoring for contextual cueing V2.

name: Contextual Search Contextual Cues Handle Edu
description: Enables Contextual Search contextual cues for education pages.

name: Cookie Binding Cookie Upgrade
description: Enables upgrading unbound session cookies to be hardware-bound on supported device platforms.

name: Credential Management Unified UI
description: Enables the Unified UI for the credential management password APIs.

name: Critical Actions in History
description: Surfaces critical actions, such as password fills and file downloads, performed during user-initiated AI agent browsing sessions alongside page visits on the Chrome History page for transparency and auditing.

name: Cross-Device Sign-in From Desktop
description: Enables entry points to sign in on a mobile phone using provided QR code.

name: Cross-Device Sign-in From Desktop Follow-up
description: Enables follow-up entry points (e.g. the What's New page) to sign in on a mobile phone using provided QR code. Requires #cross-device-signin-from-desktop.

name: Cross-Device Theme Tracker
description: Enables tracking and querying theme configurations across devices to facilitate theme imports and badge indicators.

name: Cryptography Compliance (CNSA)
description: If enabled, Chrome will configure its preferred algorithms for TLS to prefer algorithms that satisfy the requirements of the Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite (CNSA) versions 1.0 and 2.0. Enabling this flag does not guarantee that any specific algorithms will be negotiated. This flag is not required for security.

name: CSS Gamut Mapping
description: Enable experimental CSS gamut mapping implementation.

name: CUPS IPP Printing Backend
description: Use the CUPS IPP printing backend instead of the original CUPS backend that calls the PPD API.

name: Customize Chrome Side Panel Extension Card
description: If enabled, shows an extension card within the Customize Chrome Side Panel for access to the Chrome Web Store extensions.

name: Customize Chrome Wallpaper Search
description: Enables wallpaper search in Customize Chrome Side Panel.

name: Customize Chrome Wallpaper Search Button
description: Enables entry point on Customize Chrome Side Panel's Appearance page for Wallpaper Search.

name: CWS Info Fast Check
description: When enabled, Chrome checks and fetches metadata for installed extensions more frequently.

name: CWS Review Prompting Native UI
description: Enables native UI affordances (e.g., in the Extensions menu and management page) for leaving reviews on installed Chrome Web Store extensions.

name: Dark Mode Surface Tokens
description: When enabled, updates the surface tokens for dark mode.

name: Data Controls enforcement for search context menu item
description: Enables the Enterprise Data Controls for restricting data exfiltration with the "Search with..." context menu item.

name: Data Sharing
description: Enabled all Data Sharing related UI and features.

name: Data Sharing Join Only
description: Enabled Data Sharing Joining flow related UI and features.

name: Data Sharing server environment
description: Sets data sharing server environment.

name: DCHECKs are fatal
description: By default Chrome will evaluate in this build, but only log failures, rather than crashing. If enabled, DCHECKs will crash the calling process.

name: Debugging keyboard shortcuts
description: Enables additional keyboard shortcuts that are useful for debugging Ash.

name: Debugging tools for UI
description: Enables additional keyboard shortcuts to help debugging.

name: Default ANGLE Vulkan
description: Use the Vulkan backend for ANGLE by default.

name: Default Browser Changed OS Notification
description: Enables the framework to show OS Notification when Chrome is no longer the default browser.

name: Default Browser Framework
description: Enables the default browser framework.

name: Default Browser Prompt Surfaces
description: Enables using various default browser prompt surfaces.

name: Default Browser Setter Selection
description: Enables selecting a default browser setter (e.g. shell integration, visual guide).

name: Default Browser settings page - updated strings
description: Improves the flow and the wording on the Default Browser settings page.

name: Default Browser Sticky Modal
description: Enables the sticky modal dialog for the default browser prompt. Requires #default-browser-prompt-surfaces to be set to a modal dialog variation.

name: Default Search Engine preload 2
description: Enables new DSE preload instead of existing one, which uses //content prefetch

name: Default Search Engine preload 2, on-press triggers
description: Enables on-press triggers of DsePreload2

name: Default search engine prewarm
description: Performance optimization to prewarm the default search engine used in the Omnibox

name: Default SiteInstanceGroups
description: Put sites that don't need isolation in their own SiteInstance in a defaultSiteInstanceGroup (per BrowsingContextGroup) instead of in a default SiteInstance.

name: Deprecate the unload event
description: Controls the default for Permissions-Policy unload. If enabled, unload handlers are deprecated and will not receive the unload event unless a Permissions-Policy to enable them has been explicitly set. If  disabled, unload handlers will continue to receive the unload event unless explicitly disabled by Permissions-Policy, even during the gradual rollout of their deprecation.

name: Desktop Glow Up
description: Enables all Desktop Glow Up features.

name: Desktop PWA Link Capturing
description: Enables opening links from Chrome in an installed PWA. Currently under reimplementation.

name: Desktop PWA Link Capturing Default On For Testing
description: Enables opening links from Chrome in an installed PWA by default for testing.

name: Desktop PWA tab strips settings
description: Experimental UI for selecting whether a PWA should open in tabbed mode.

name: Desktop PWAs elided extensions menu
description: Moves the Extensions "puzzle piece" icon from the title bar into the app menu for web app windows.

name: Desktop Screenshots
description: Enables taking screenshots from the desktop sharing hub.

name: Device Bound Session Credentials
description: Enables Google session credentials binding to cryptographic keys.

name: Device Bound Session Credentials (Standard)
description: Enables the official version of Device Bound Session Credentials. For more information see https://github.com/WICG/dbsc.

name: Device Bound Session Credentials (Standard) on Google
description: Enables Device Bound Session Credentials (Standard) to register sessions on Google sites

name: Dialog UI for HTTPS-First Modes
description: Use a dialog-based UI for HFM

name: Dictation
description: Enables the Dictation feature.

name: DigitalCredentials
description: Enables the three-party verifier/holder/issuer identity model.

name: DigitalCredentialsCreation
description: Enables the Digital Credentials Creation API.

name: Disable subframe process reuse
description: Prevents out-of-process iframes from reusing compatible processes from unrelated tabs. This is an experimental mode that will result in more processes being created.

name: Disable the Autofill strike system
description: When enabled, the Autofill strike system will not block a feature from being offered.

name: Disable the country check for BNPL testing
description: Enables testing BNPL in countries where it would otherwise be disabled.

name: Document Picture-in-Picture Animate Resize
description: Use an animation when programmatically resizing a documentpicture-in-picture window

name: DOM Storage SQLite Backend
description: Uses a SQLite-powered backing store for local and session storage. No data is migrated from existing backing stores, including LevelDB stores or SQLite stores with older schemas; use at your own peril.

name: Dynamic Aim Submit
description: Enables dynamic aim button submission variants.

name: Elastic Overscroll
description: Enables Elastic Overscrolling on touchscreens and precision touchpads.

name: Element Capture cross-tab
description: Allows the Element Capture API to be used cross-tab. (Only has an effect if Element Capture is generally enabled.)

name: Email Verification Protocol
description: Enables the Email Verification Protocol in Autofill.

name: Enable 3DS authentication for virtual cards
description: When enabled, Chrome will trigger 3DS authentication during a virtual card retrieval if a challenge is required, 3DS authentication is available for the card, and FIDO is not.

name: Enable Account Preview Data
description: Enables fetching and storing account preview data for signed-in accounts.

name: Enable Account Preview Entity Previews
description: Enables fetching and storing entity preview data for signed-in accounts.

name: Enable Account Preview Preferred Account
description: Controls whether storing and exposing the preferred account is enabled.

name: Enable Account Preview Switching Account
description: Controls whether storing and exposing the preferred account for switching is enabled.

name: Enable AI Subscription Avatar Ring
description: Enables the AI subscription level decorative ring around the user's avatar.

name: Enable AI-based card recommendations on Autofill
description: When enabled, AI-based card recommendations will be offered on Autofill when at least two credit card suggestions are shown.

name: Enable AI-based checkout amount extraction on Chrome
description: When enabled, Chrome will extract the checkout amount from the checkout page using server-side AI.

name: Enable Ambient sign-in for WebAuthn get requests
description: Enables ambient sign-in for passkeys and passwords from a navigator.credentials.get() request. This is similar to conditional UI with the main difference being it does not use autofill UI.

name: Enable amount extraction testing
description: Enables testing of the result of checkout amount extraction. This flag will allow amount extraction to run on any website when a CC form is clicked.

name: Enable Autofill Cardholder Name Fix Flow
description: When enabled, prompts users to confirm their cardholder name when checking out with a server card that is missing a name, if a name was found.

name: Enable Autofill for Wallet Direct Offers
description: When enabled, direct offers synced via Google Wallet will be available for autofill into merchant promo code fields during checkout.

name: Enable Autofill OAuth2 token fix
description: When enabled, Autofill payments requests fetch OAuth2 tokens from the identity service on each request, instead of keeping local cache in Autofill components.

name: Enable AV1 video encoding for Cast Streaming
description: Offers the AV1 video codec when negotiating Cast Streaming, and uses AV1 if selected for the session.

name: Enable buy now pay later on Autofill
description: When enabled, users will have the option to pay with buy now pay later on specific merchant webpages.

name: Enable buy now pay later on Autofill for Klarna
description: When enabled, users will have the option to pay with buy now pay later with Klarna on specific merchant webpages.

name: Enable caching field classification predictions
description: When enabled, the field classification model uses runtime caching to not run models on the same inputs multiple times.

name: Enable Card Benefits in-product help bubble
description: Enables In-Product-Help that appears when at least one autofill credit card suggestion includes card benefits.

name: Enable checkout amount extraction.
description: When enabled, Chrome will extract the checkout amount from the checkout page of the allowlisted merchant websites.

name: Enable Chrome Web Store Promotion Banner
description: Enables showing the promotion banner on chromewebstore page.

name: Enable chrome.mimeHandler extension API
description: Enables the chrome.mimeHandler extension API for extensions with a mime_types_handler manifest entry. The API is currently limited to a small set of MIME types (e.g. application/pdf).

name: Enable content analysis clipboard copy
description: Enables content analysis checks for the clipboard copy action.

name: Enable Cross-Device Pref Tracker
description: Enables the tracking and sharing of select non-syncing preference values across a user's signed-in devices.

name: Enable CTA experiment for sign-in level up
description: As part of the Sign In Level Up experiment, changes the decline sign in CTA string in profile creation entry points

name: Enable delegated compositing
description: When enabled and applicable, the act of compositing is delegated to the system compositor.

name: Enable Device Bound Session Credentials Prewarmer for Default Search Engine
description: Enables preemptive refreshes for sessions registered in the same site as the default search engine when the user is not actively navigating.

name: Enable EnterprisePublishedSkills policy
description: Enables the EnterprisePublishedSkills policy in Chrome.

name: Enable Expand IBAN Regex Pattern
description: When enabled, IBAN regex pattern matching is expanded to support more formats.

name: Enable Extension Install Policy Fetching
description: Enables fetching of extension install policies from the cloud for the ExtensionInstallCloudPolicyChecksEnabled policy.

name: Enable extension permission omnibox.directInput
description: Allows extensions to request permission omnibox.directInput, which enables unscoped mode in the Omnibox

name: Enable GameInput data fetcher
description: Enables Gamepad API to use GameInput for gamepad access.

name: Enable Gmail OTP Pre-launch Metrics
description: Enables pre-launch metrics for one-time passwords (OTPs) received in Gmail.

name: Enable gpu service logging
description: Enable printing the actual GL driver calls.

name: Enable gradient-style GPay and Wallet logos
description: When enabled, gradient-style GPay and Wallet branding logos will be used.

name: Enable hardware H264 video encoding on for Cast Streaming on macOS
description: Offers the H264 video codec when negotiating Cast Streaming, and uses hardware-accelerated H264 encoding if selected for the session

name: Enable hardware H264 video encoding on for Cast Streaming on Windows
description: Offers the H264 video codec when negotiating Cast Streaming, and uses hardware-accelerated H264 encoding if selected for the session

name: Enable Isolated Web App Developer Mode
description: Enables the installation of unverified Isolated Web Apps

name: Enable Isolated Web App Fast Update Check
description: Enables fast update checks for Isolated Web Apps, reducing the update check interval to 1 minute.

name: Enable Isolated Web Apps
description: Enables experimental support for Isolated Web Apps. See https://github.com/reillyeon/isolated-web-apps for more information.

name: Enable Launch Chrome on Startup prompt
description: When enabled, shows an infobar prompting to launch Chrome on Windows startup

name: Enable launching Chrome on Windows startup
description: When enabled, Launch Chrome on Startup can be turned on from Settings

name: Enable Lens features in Chrome.
description: Enables Lens image and region search to learn about the visual content you see while you browse and shop on the web.

name: Enable Lens Overlay Virtual Focus Navigation
description: Enables virtual focus keyboard navigation within the Lens Overlay searchbox.

name: Enable location provider manager for Geolocation API
description: Enables usage of the location provider manager to select between the operating system's location API or the network-based provider as the data source for Geolocation API.

name: Enable Management Promotion Banner
description: Enables showing the management promotion banner on chrome://management page.

name: Enable network logging to file
description: Enables network logging to a file named netlog.json in the user data directory. The file can be imported into chrome://net-internals.

name: Enable new tab page browser feature suggestions
description: Shows suggestions to explore browser capabilities (eg. signing in) on the new tab page.

name: Enable offering upload of Autofilled credit cards
description: Enables a new option to upload credit cards to Google Payments for sync to all Chrome devices.

name: Enable Omnibox Autofill chip for Google Pay buttons
description: When enabled, a Google Pay omnibox chip will appear when a Google Pay button is detected on the page, and clicking the chip will simulate clicking the Google Pay button.

name: Enable Omnibox Autofill chip for payments
description: When enabled, an Autofill payments omnibox chip will appear for relevant payment checkout forms.

name: Enable Omnibox Everywhere Virtual Focus Navigation
description: Enables virtual focus keyboard navigation within Omnibox Everywhere.

name: Enable password sharing with remote actors
description: Enables remote actors to request passwords from the signed in Google account. When requested, the user will be prompted to select a password and authenticate.

name: Enable Pay Now Pay Later tabs UI for payments autofill on Chrome
description: When enabled, Chrome will use the Pay Now Pay Later tabs UI for payments autofill when buy now pay later options are available for the merchant webpage.

name: Enable payment QR code detection
description: When enabled, QR code detection for facilitated payments will be supported on Desktop and Android.

name: Enable Perfetto system tracing
description: When enabled, Chrome will attempt to connect to the system tracing service

name: Enable Ping SSO for enterprise browsers.
description: Enables native support for Ping Identity SSO on managed MacOS devices.

name: Enable pixel canvas recording
description: Pixel canvas recording allows the compositor to raster contents aligned with the pixel and improves text rendering. This should be enabled when a device is using fractional scale factor.

name: Enable Process Isolation UI
description: Shows the Enable Process Isolation toggle in chrome://settings/system.

name: Enable ProcessPerSite up to main frame threshold
description: Proactively reuses same-site renderer processes to host multiple main frames, up to a certain threshold.

name: Enable protocol monitor in DevTools
description: Enables the protocol monitor panel, which displays the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) traffic between DevTools and the browser.

name: Enable PWA install dialog pinning option
description: Enables the option to pin PWA to taskbar in the PWA install dialog.

name: Enable PWA install update dialog for icon changes
description: Enable a confirmation dialog that shows up when a PWA changes its icon

name: Enable Realbox Virtual Focus Navigation
description: Enables a new virtual focus model for keyboard navigation within the New Tab Page Realbox. This allows tabbing through all interactive elements within suggestions (actions, buttons) without losing focus from the searchbox, unifying behavior with the Omnibox and improving accessibility.

name: Enable RenderDocument
description: Enable swapping RenderFrameHosts on same-site navigations

name: Enable resurrecting churned payments users
description: When enabled, users that have previously turned off payments autofill will be prompted to turn it back on in instances where they can benefit from it.

name: Enable risk-based authentication for FPAN retrieval
description: When enabled, server card retrieval will begin with a risk-based check instead of jumping straight to CVC or biometric auth.

name: Enable SecurityInfo in WebRequest API
description: Enables SecurityInfo in WebRequest API for extensions, allowing listeners to retrieve certificate details of web requests.

name: Enable syncing buy now pay later user data.
description: When enabled, Chrome will sync user data related to buy now pay later.

name: Enable Test-only MTC Root Store (UNSAFE)
description: Enable MTC certificate verification based on test-only roots. This is unsafe and may permit an attacker to intercept or modify your HTTPS connections. Do not use this flag on an instance containing personal data. Recommended for developer use only in isolated testing environments

name: Enable text editing through accessibility APIs
description: Enables support for performing text editing operations through the AXTextOperation accessibility API.

name: Enable the In Stock Notification Manager
description: Enables detecting, showing, and subscribing to back-in-stock notifications on eligible product pages.

name: Enable the Iwa Key Distribution component
description: Enables the Iwa Key Distribution component that supplies key rotation data for Isolated Web Apps.

name: Enable the network service sandbox.
description: Enables a sandbox around the network service to help mitigate exploits in its process. This may cause crashes if Kerberos is used.

name: Enable the Plus Button in DevTools
description: Shows a Plus Button in main DevTools panel/drawer tabbed locations, replacing the "More tools" overflow menu.

name: Enable toolbar Gemini button on horizontal tab strip
description: Enables the toolbar Gemini button when the horizontal tab strip is enabled, and disables the tab strip Gemini button.

name: Enable Unexportable Key Deletion
description: Enables the garbage collection and deletion of obsolete cryptographic keys used for Device Bound Session Credentials.

name: Enable Unexportable Keys Spare Key Pool
description: Enables in-memory spare key pooling for unexportable keys to reduce latency.

name: Enable UnexportableKeyService mojo service in the browser process.
description: When enabled, the browser process will create an Unexportable Key Service which can be used by other, less privileged processes. This enables DBSC in platforms where access to TPM-like features is privileged.

name: Enable VP8 video encoding for Cast Streaming
description: Offers the VP8 video codec when negotiating Cast Streaming, and uses VP8 if selected for the session. If true, software VP8 encoding will be offered and hardware VP8 encoding may be offered if enabled and available on this platform. If false, software VP8 will not be offered and hardware VP8 will only be offered if #cast-streaming-hardware-vp8 is explicitly set to true.

name: Enable VP9 video encoding for Cast Streaming
description: Offers the VP9 video codec when negotiating Cast Streaming, and uses VP9 if selected for the session.

name: Enable Wallet Gmail offers
description: When enabled, offers from Gmail are synced via Google Wallet in addition to direct offers.

name: Enable Wallet Reminder Notice for cards
description: When enabled, shows the Wallet Reminder Notice prompt or bottom sheet for cards after payment form submission.

name: Enable WebUI Browser Virtual Focus Navigation
description: Enables virtual focus keyboard navigation within the WebUI Browser searchbox.

name: Enable Youtube OAuthMultilogin Cookies Binding
description: When enabled, Chrome will send a specific URL parameter to Gaia to trigger the server-side experiment for binding the OAuthMultilogin cookies for Youtube to cryptographic keys.

name: Enable Zero-Copy Video Capture
description: Camera produces a gpu friendly buffer on capture and, if there is, hardware accelerated video encoder consumes the buffer

name: Enables AIM in Lens side panel.
description: Enables AIM follow ups with the Lens overlay results side panel.

name: Enables canvas 2D methods BeginLayer and EndLayer
description: Enables the canvas 2D methods BeginLayer and EndLayer.

name: Enables Cast Streaming to offer only hardware accelerated codecs first
description: When enabled, the Cast Streaming session negotiates only the hardware accelerated codecs first, and only offers software encoding if the receiver rejects the initial offer.

name: Enables Display Compositor to use a new gpu thread.
description: When enabled, chrome uses 2 gpu threads instead of 1.  Display compositor uses new dr-dc gpu thread and all other clients (raster, webgl, video)  continues using the gpu main thread.

name: Enables logging of all Cast messages.
description: Enables logging of all messages exchanged between websites, Chrome, and Cast receivers in chrome://media-router-internals.

name: Enables Out-of-Process Printer Drivers
description: Enables printing interactions with the operating system to be performed out-of-process.

name: Energy Effect
description: Enables the Energy Effect for the Realbox.

name: Energy Effect Animation
description: Enables animations for the Energy Effect for the Realbox.

name: Enterprise Signin Dialogs Refresh
description: Enables the visually refreshed enterprise signin dialogs (enterprise profile welcome/creation, OIDC and the device signals disclaimer). It is no-op if `first-run-desktop-refresh` is disabled.

name: Enterprise Tab Title Reporting
description: Enables the reporting of destination tab titles in Chrome Enterprise URL navigation logs.

name: Exclude Picture-in-Picture windows from screen capture
description: When enabled, Picture-in-Picture windows will be excluded from screen captures.

name: Expansion pack for the Site search starter pack
description: Enables additional providers for the Site search starter pack feature

name: Experimental JavaScript
description: Enable web pages to use experimental JavaScript features.

name: Experimental system keyboard lock
description: Enables websites to use the keyboard.lock() API to intercept system keyboard shortcuts and have the events routed directly to the website when in fullscreen mode.

name: Experimental Web Payments API features
description: Enable experimental Web Payments API features

name: Experimental WebAssembly Shared-Everything Threads
description: Enable web pages to use the experimental WebAssembly Shared-Everything Threads feature. Note that this only covers a subset of the proposal.

name: Export Platform Policies as JSON
description: Enables a button on chrome://policy to export platform-source policies in a custom flat JSON configuration schema.

name: Extensibility API support for deep-links within DevTools
description: Extends console.timestamp to support adding deep-links into the DevTools Performance Panel, which (when clicked) call into a DevTools extension

name: Extension Install Site Access Options
description: Enables an 'Allow site access' section in the extension install dialog to let users choose default site permissions on install.

name: Extension Tab Context Menu
description: Allowing extensions to add custom items when right-clicking a tab.

name: Extensions Contextual Tasks API
description: Enables the contextualTasksPrivate API and contextual tasks component extension.

name: Extensions Menu Access Control
description: Enables a redesigned extensions menu that allows the user to control extensions site access.

name: Extensions on chrome-extension:// URLs
description: Enables running extensions on chrome-extension:// URLs, where extensions explicitly request this permission.

name: Extensions on chrome:// URLs
description: Enables running extensions on chrome:// URLs, where extensions explicitly request this permission.

name: FedCM Ambient Bubble
description: Shows FedCM accounts for passive mode requests in an ambient bubble, instead of the regular FedCM dialog. This is separate from the FedCM ambient UI in the omnibox (#fedcm-ambient-ui).

name: FedCm Ambient UI
description: Enables FedCM ambient UI in the omnibox.

name: FedCM with delegation support
description: Enables IdPs to delegate presentation to the browser.

name: FedCM with IdP Registration support
description: Enables RPs to get identity credentials from registered IdPs.

name: FedCmActiveModeMultipleIdentityProviders
description: Enables Active Mode support with multiple Identity Providers in FedCM.

name: FedCmAutofill
description: Allows RPs to enhance autofill with FedCM.

name: FedCmLightweightMode
description: Enables IdPs to store user profile information using the login status API.

name: FedCmMetricsEndpoint
description: Allows the FedCM API to send performance measurement to the metrics endpoint on the identity provider side. Requires FedCM to be enabled.

name: FedCmNavigationInterception
description: Allows IdP to intercept navigations by initiating a FedCM request.

name: FedCmNonceInParams
description: Removes nonce as an explicit parameter of the FedCM API. When enabled, a nonce may be passed in params.

name: FedCmSegmentationPlatform
description: Enables the segmentation platform service to provide UI volume recommendations to FedCM.

name: FedCmWebIdentitySubdomain
description: Enables subdomain-first discovery for the FedCM well-known file. Fetches https://web-identity.<eTLD+1>/.well-known/web-identity first and falls back to the apex URL on failure.

name: FedCmWellKnownEndpointValidation
description: When enabled, accounts_endpoint and login_url must be present in .well-known/web-identity if client_metadata is used.

name: FedCmWithoutWellKnownEnforcement
description: Supports configURL that's not in the IdP's .well-known file.

name: Feedback Disabled Dialog
description: Enables the dialog shown when user feedback is disabled.

name: Fill passwords on account selection
description: Filling of passwords when an account is explicitly selected by the user rather than autofilling credentials on page load.

name: Filter Browsing History By Actor
description: Enables browser history filtering by actor on Android. On desktop this changes the existing actor filter UI to dropdown menu.

name: Filter Browsing History By Device
description: Enables browser history filtering by device.

name: Filter Browsing History By Time
description: Enables browser history filtering by time.

name: First Run Desktop Choice Screen Refresh
description: Enables the visually refreshed first run and profile creation flows, including the choice screen (FRE and dialog versions), for users in search engine choice screen regions. It is no-op if `first-run-desktop-refresh` is disabled.

name: First Run Desktop Refresh
description: Enables the visually refreshed first run and profile creation flows in users outside of search engine choice screen regions. To enable the refresh in search engine choice screen regions, enable `first-run-desktop-choice-screen-refresh` as well.

name: First Run Desktop Revamp
description: Enables the first run revamp (new UI and additional effects). It is no-op if `first-run-desktop-refresh` is disabled.

name: Focus Selection
description: Allows focusing a selection of ungrouped tabs in the tabstrip.

name: Force Drive Disclaimer Accepted
description: Whether to force the Google Drive disclaimer to be accepted. This flag is only used for testing purposes.

name: Force enable WebGPU interop
description: Force enable the WebGPU on vulkan via GL compositing interop.

name: Force High Performance GPU
description: Forces use of high performance GPU if available. Warning: this flag may increase power consumption leading to shorter battery time.

name: Force iOS Promo Type
description: Force the iOS promo to be a specific type (QRCode or Reminder) for testing purposes.

name: Forced Colors
description: Enables forced colors mode for web content.

name: Further update Google Pay and Google Wallet branding where applicable
description: When enabled, further brings certain strings and images referencing Google Pay and Google Wallet into consistency with branding requirements.

name: Future V8 VM features
description: This enables upcoming and experimental V8 VM features. This flag does not enable experimental JavaScript features.

name: Gamepad Multitouch
description: Enables the ability to receive input from multitouch surface on the gamepad object.

name: Gamepad Raw Input Change Event
description: Enables raw input change events in Gamepad API.

name: GEiC enabled
description: Controls Gemini Enterprise in Chrome (GEiC) side panel integration. Set to Enabled to apply a GeminiEnterpriseUrl policy even if this profile is not detected as a managed account. Set to Disabled to opt out of GEiC and fall back to consumer Gemini, even if a Gemini Enterprise policy or experiment applies to this profile.

name: Gemini Antiscam Protection
description: Enables querying Gemini for antiscam protection signals and collecting metrics.

name: getDisplayMedia() confers transient activation.
description: When getDisplay() is invoked by the application, the user is shown a dialog which allows them to share a tab, a window or a screen. If this flag is enabled, then after the user chooses what to share, transient activation is conferred on the Web application.

name: Glass Frame
description: Enables a glass effect on the browser frame.

name: Glic
description: Enables glic

name: Glic actor autofill
description: Enables autofill actions for the Glic actor. Specific fillable types may also need to be enabled.

name: Glic actor autofill pre-click
description: Enables an additional click before retrieving suggestions. Only effective if Glic actor autofill is also enabled.

name: Glic actor autofill section label
description: Enables the section label in Glic actor autofill. Only effective if Glic actor autofill is also enabled.

name: Glic actor cursor
description: Enables the Glic actor cursor

name: Glic actor incremental typing
description: When enabled, the Glic actor types text one key at a time with a short delay between keystrokes. When disabled, it dispatches all keystrokes at once.

name: Glic actor script tools
description: Enables script tools for the Glic actor.

name: Glic actor skip screenshots
description: If enabled, Glic actor will skip capturing and uploading screenshots when an actor turn is completed.

name: Glic actor transient tasks
description: Support for transient tasks in actor. If enabled, all tasks will use the transient actor UI.

name: Glic background actuation
description: Enables background actuation for Glic.

name: Glic background triggering
description: Enables background triggering for Glic.

name: Glic CAA Guest Error
description: Enables the Glic CAA Guest Error UI when there are authentication issues.

name: Glic Capture Region
description: Enables Glic to capture a region of the screen.

name: Glic Chrome Status Icon Windows
description: Use an alt logo as glic OS status bar icon on Windows.

name: Glic Context Menu Below Search
description: Places the Glic (Ask Gemini) context menu entry point below the Search option.

name: Glic Contextual Cueing v2 Active User Backoff
description: Prevents showing the v2 contextual cue UI for Glic if the user recently invoked Glic.

name: Glic Contextual Cueing v2 Auto Submit
description: Enable automatically submitting a suggested prompt when the v2 contextual cue UI for Glic is clicked.

name: Glic Contextual Cues Handle Edu
description: Enables Glic contextual cues for education pages.

name: Glic Contextual Cues Handle Shopping
description: Enables Glic contextual cues for shopping pages.

name: Glic Daisy chain new tabs
description: Daisy chains new tabs if the active tab when the new tab was create has an open glic side panel

name: Glic Default Tab Context Setting
description: Controls whether tab context is enabled by default within new Glic sessions. Required for Side Panel.

name: Glic disable actor safety checks
description: Disables actor safety checks in Glic. Use with extreme caution, intended for testing only.

name: Glic Disable HFCR
description: Disables the High Frequency Cookie Rotation frame in Glic.

name: Glic experimental triggering
description: Enables GLIC experimental triggering

name: Glic Experimental Triggering OS Notification
description: Enables OS-level system notifications for Glic experimental triggering task starts when no browser window is active.

name: Glic experimental triggering screenshot
description: Enables secure client-side screenshot capture and encryption on yield for Glic experimental triggering tasks.

name: Glic experimental triggering script tool execution
description: Enables direct ScriptTool action execution for Glic experimental triggering tasks.

name: Glic guest URL presets
description: Overrides the Bluebird environment URL used for Glic with user-configured values. Intended for manual testing only.

name: Glic handoff button hide when modal UI shown
description: Hides the Glic handoff button when a tab-modal UI is active.

name: Glic Hotkey Local Scope
description: Limits the Glic global hotkey to local scope (active browser window).

name: Glic Message First FRE
description: Enables the message-first first run experience (FRE), which opens Glic directly to chat with inline consent instead of the standard FRE when the user has not yet consented.

name: Glic Message First FRE for Contextual Cue
description: Enables the message-first first run experience (FRE) when auto-submitting from a contextual cue.

name: Glic Opt-in dialog accessibility fix
description: Fixes Glic opt-in dialog accessibility issues by adding an accessible title and redirecting initial focus.

name: Glic OS Status Icon Variant
description: Select the variant of the Glic OS status bar icon on Mac.

name: Glic Pdf Summarize
description: Enables the pdf summarize button.

name: Glic Pre-Warming
description: Enables the pre-warming of the Glic panel's web client.

name: Glic Print Menu Item
description: Enables showing the Glic print contextual menu item.

name: Glic Reuse Cookies
description: Reuses existing cookies if possible when synchronizing cookies in Glic.

name: Glic Share Image
description: Enables the Create Image with Gemini context menu item

name: Glic Show, not Tell Tutorials
description: Enables Show, not Tell Tutorials in Gemini in Chrome.

name: Glic Spark Settings Accessible Labels
description: Enables screen reader accessible labels for links in the Gemini Spark settings page.

name: Glic SSR
description: Enables server-side rendering for Glic.

name: Glic Tab Groups
description: Enables Glic to integrate with tab groups.

name: Glic Toolbar Button Location
description: Specifies the location of the toolbar Gemini button.

name: Glic Use Toolbar Height Side Panel
description: Enables Glic to use the toolbar height side panel instead of content height side panel when enabled to use side panel

name: Glic Web Actuation Accessibility Context Fix
description: Enables accessible aria-label attributes on Web Actuation settings links for screen reader context.

name: Glic zero state suggestions
description: Enables the Glic zero state suggestions.

name: Global lock on the VA-API wrapper.
description: Enable or disable the global VA-API lock for platforms and paths that support controlling this.

name: Group Promo Prototype
description: Enables prototype for group promo.

name: Happiness Tracking Surveys Demo
description: Enable showing Happiness Tracking Surveys Demo to users on Desktop

name: Happy Eyeballs Version 3
description: Enables the Happy Eyeballs Version 3 algorithm. See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-pauly-v6ops-happy-eyeballs-v3/

name: Hardware Media Key Handling
description: Enables using media keys to control the active media session. This requires MediaSessionService to be enabled too

name: Hardware Secure Decryption
description: Enable/Disable the use of hardware secure Content Decryption Module (CDM) for protected content playback.

name: Hardware Secure Decryption Fallback
description: Allows automatically disabling hardware secure Content Decryption Module (CDM) after failures or crashes. Subsequent playback may use software secure CDMs. If this feature is disabled, the fallback will never happen and users could be stuck with playback failures.

name: Headless Caption Early Start
description: Start headless captioning as soon as a profile is loaded.

name: Headless Live Captions
description: Enable features related to headless captions exploration. These are very likely unstable.

name: Heavy ad privacy mitigations
description: Enables privacy mitigations for the heavy ad intervention. Disabling this makes the intervention deterministic. Defaults to enabled.

name: Hibernation for 2D canvas
description: Enables canvas hibernation for 2D canvas.

name: Hide contextual suggestion group headers in the Omnibox popup
description: If enabled, contextual suggestion group headers will be hidden in the Omnibox popup (e.g. to minimize visual clutter in the zero-prefix state)

name: Hide suggestion group headers in the Omnibox popup
description: If enabled, suggestion group headers will be hidden in the Omnibox popup (e.g. to minimize visual clutter in the zero-prefix state)

name: HiDPI tab capture support for Cast Streaming
description: Enables HiDPI tab capture during Cast Streaming mirroring sessions. May reduce performance on some platforms and also improve quality of video frames.

name: History Sync Alternative Illustration
description: Enables history sync alternative illustration.

name: HTTP Headers Injection
description: Enables injection of custom HTTP headers in network requests.

name: HTTPS Upgrades
description: Enable automatically upgrading all top-level navigations to HTTPS with fast fallback to HTTP.

name: HTTPS-First Mode For Typically Secure Users
description: Automatically enables HTTPS-First Mode if the user has a typically secure browsing pattern.

name: HTTPS-First Mode in Incognito
description: Enable HTTPS-First Mode in Incognito as default setting.

name: HTTPS-First Mode V2 For Engaged Sites
description: Enable Site-Engagement based HTTPS-First Mode. Shows HTTPS-First Mode interstitial on sites whose HTTPS URLs have high Site Engagement scores. Requires #https-upgrades feature to be enabled

name: IDB SQLite Backing Store
description: Uses a SQLite-powered backing store for IndexedDB. No data is migrated from existing backing stores, including LevelDB stores or SQLite stores with older schemas; use at your own peril.

name: Immersive Reading Mode Print
description: Enables printing the distilled content from immersive Reading mode.

name: Import and export flags
description: Enables importing and exporting flags from chrome://flags.

name: In-flow resolution of errors during password saving
description: Starts the password manager error resolution flow after offering to save a password.

name: In-Product Help Demo Mode
description: Selects the In-Product Help demo mode.

name: InfoBar queued count pill
description: Shows a "+N" count pill in the bottom-most InfoBar while lower-priority InfoBars wait in the prioritization queue.

name: Input protection
description: Enables input protection by blocking interaction with views that are currently or were recently obscured by always-on-top windows, and prevents unintended events on security-sensitive UI that appears and activates unexpectedly.

name: Instrumentation breakpoints
description: Enables instrumentation breakpoints in DevTools.

name: IPH Autofill AI Valuables
description: Enables the In-Product Help for Autofill AI valuables.

name: IPH Desktop Realbox Contextual Search
description: Enables In-Product Help for Desktop Realbox Contextual Search.

name: IPH Extensions Menu
description: Enables In-Product-Help that appears when at least one extension has access to the current page. This feature is gated by extensions-menu-access-control.

name: IPH Extensions Request Access Button Feature
description: Enables In-Product-Help that appears when at least one extension is requesting access to the current page. This feature is gated by extensions-menu-access-control.

name: IPH message for the Site search starter pack
description: Enables an informational IPH message for the  Site search starter pack feature

name: Isolated sandboxed iframes
description: When enabled, applies process isolation to iframes with the 'sandbox' attribute and without the 'allow-same-origin' permission set on that attribute. This also applies to documents with a similar CSP sandbox header, even in the main frame. The affected sandboxed documents can be grouped into processes based on their URL's site or origin. The default grouping when enabled is per-site.

name: Lens AIM M3 Side Panel Suggestions
description: Enables suggestions in the Lens composebox. This will have an effect only when the Lens search AIM M3 flag is also enabled.

name: Lens AIM M3 Side Panel Suggestions Gradient Background
description: Enables a gradient background for the Lens composebox dropdown that does not cover the entire side panel.

name: Lens Bypass Compression for C2PA
description: Bypasses image downscaling and compression if a C2PA metadata urn is detected, ensuring provenance is preserved during upload. Works across all surfaces.

name: Lens Composebox Identity Delegation
description: Enables identity delegation in the Lens composebox.

name: Lens overlay
description: Enables Lens search via an overlay on any page.

name: Lens Overlay EDU action chip
description: Enables Lens Overlay EDU action chip. Intended for testing the chip itself, not its triggering criteria.

name: Lens overlay force empty CSB query
description: Forces Lens overlay to issue an empty CSB query on invocation.

name: Lens overlay image context menu actions
description: Enables image context menu actions in the Lens overlay.

name: Lens overlay latency optimizations
description: Enables latency optimizations for the Lens overlay.

name: Lens overlay non-blocking privacy notice
description: Enables non-blocking privacy notice in the Lens overlay.

name: Lens Overlay Omnibox entrypoint
description: Enables icon button for Lens entrypoint in the Omnibox.

name: Lens overlay permission bubble alt appearance
description: Enables Lens overlay permission bubble alt appearance.

name: Lens overlay side panel open in new tab
description: Enables open in new tab in the Lens overlay side panel.

name: Lens overlay translate button
description: Enables translate button via the Lens overlay.

name: Lens overlay updated visuals
description: Enables updated visuals in the Lens selection overlay.

name: Lens search reinvocation affordance
description: Enables the Lens button in the AIM Searchbox for reinvocation of selection overlay.

name: Lens Side Panel Unification
description: Unifies the Lens and Contextual Tasks side panels into a single panel.

name: Lens updated feedback entrypoint
description: Enables an updated feedback entry point in the Lens side panel.

name: Lens Use Separate Request ID for Viewport Images
description: Enables using separate request IDs for page contents vs page viewport uploads.

name: Lens video citations
description: Enables special handling for video citations in Lens.

name: Linux System Audio Loopback for Cast (pulseaudio)
description: Enable system audio mirroring when casting a screen on Linux with pulseaudio.

name: Linux System Audio Loopback for Screen Sharing (pulseaudio)
description: Enable system audio sharing when screen sharing on Linux with pulseaudio.

name: Local Network Access Checks
description: Enables Local Network Access checks. See: https://chromestatus.com/feature/5152728072060928

name: Local Network Access Checks for WebRTC
description: Enable Local Network Access checks for WebRTC. Requires the #local-network-access-check flag to also be enabled See: https://chromestatus.com/feature/5065884686876672

name: Local Network Access Checks for WebSockets
description: Enable Local Network Access checks for WebSockets. Requires the #local-network-access-check flag to also be enabled See: https://chromestatus.com/feature/5197681148428288

name: Local Network Access Checks for WebTransport
description: Enable Local Network Access checks for WebTransport. Requires the #local-network-access-check flag to also be enabled See: https://chromestatus.com/feature/5126430912544768

name: Log Omnibox URL Scoring Signals
description: Enables Omnibox to log scoring signals of URL suggestions.

name: Mac A11y API Migration
description: Enables the migration to the new Cocoa accessibility API.

name: Mac Core Audio Tap System Loopback Capture for Cast
description: Enable system audio loopback capture for Cast using the macOS CoreAudio tap API on macOS 14.2+.

name: Mac PWA notification attribution
description: Route notifications for PWAs on Mac through the app shim, attributing notifications to the correct apps.

name: Mac Sandbox Logging
description: Enables sandbox violation logging on macOS. Useful for determining whether an isuse is the result of an unexpected sandbox denial and for debugging issues that stem from sandbox denials.

name: MagiChrome Passkey Sign-in
description: Enables the MagiChrome passkey sign-in experiment, enabling either the Autofill promo flow or the native Views banner flow.

name: Main Node Annotations
description: Uses Screen2x main content extractor to annotate the accessibility tree with the main landmark on the node identified as main.

name: Mark all credential as leaked
description: Will pop up the leaked check dialog on every password form submission. This should be used in combination with #improved-password-change-service to better test the improved password change service

name: MBI Scheduling Mode
description: Enables independent agent cluster scheduling, via the AgentSchedulingGroup infrastructure.

name: Mdm error handling for dasher accounts
description: Enables the mdm error handling feature for dasher accounts

name: Media Foundation Camera Usage Monitoring
description: Enables the use of Media Foundation for camera usage monitoring. This allows detecting if a camera is being used by another application.

name: Media Link Helpers
description: Enable customized per-site media link processing.

name: MediaFoundation Video Capture
description: Enable/Disable the usage of MediaFoundation for video capture. Fall back to DirectShow if disabled.

name: Menu Simplification
description: Enables the menu simplification feature.

name: Migrate Enhanced Safe Browsing User to Enhanced Bundle
description: Enables the migration of enhanced Safe Browsing users to the enhanced bundle. Requires chrome://flags#bundled-security-settings to be enabled.

name: Migrate preinstalled Chat app
description: When enabled, the preinstalled Chat web app will be migrated from its old URL to a new URL. This migration only applies to users who have not manually installed the Chat app.

name: Migrate syncing user to signed in state
description: When enabled, a syncing user is migrated to the signed in non-syncing state on the next browser startup.

name: Mobile NTP Promo on Desktop
description: Enables the Mobile NTP Promo on Desktop.

name: Mobile Promo On Desktop - QR Code (Wave 1)
description: When enabled, shows a mobile promo with a QR code on desktop for eligible users. This version highlights features not included in the existing Mobile promos.

name: Mobile Promo On Desktop - QR Code (Wave 2)
description: When enabled, shows a mobile promo with a QR code on desktop for eligible users. This version highlights thematic areas as opposed to specific features.

name: Mobile Promo On Desktop - QRCode
description: When enabled, shows a mobile promo with a QR code on desktop for eligible users.

name: Mobile Promo On Desktop - Reminder
description: When enabled, shows a mobile promo with a reminder flow on desktop for eligible users.

name: Mobile Promo On Desktop - Reminder (Wave 1)
description: When enabled, shows a mobile promo with a reminder flow on desktop for eligible users. This version highlights features not included in the existing mobile promos.

name: Mobile Promo On Desktop - Reminder (Wave 2)
description: When enabled, shows a mobile promo with a reminder flow on desktop for eligible users. This version highlights thematic areas as opposed to specific features.

name: Mobile safe area emulation in DevTools
description: Enables mobile safe area emulation in DevTools.

name: More Lens overlay translate languages
description: Enables more translate languages in the Lens Overlay.

name: Most Visited Tile: New scoring function
description: When showing MV tiles, use a new scoring function to compute the score of each segment.

name: Multistep Filter
description: Allows users to quickly apply search filters when browsing supported websites. Suggestions are based on recent browsing activity and filters are saved locally on the device.

name: NativeViewHost manages layers
description: Enables NativeViewHost to control the layers of the native view.

name: Network backend linking in DevTools
description: Enables backend linking for network requests in DevTools.

name: New Horizontal Pinned Tab Styling
description: Enables the updated pinned tab style in the new horizontal tab strip.

name: NewTabPagePrefetch
description: If enabled, NewTabPage can trigger prefetch

name: NewTabPagePrerender2
description: If enabled, NewTabPage can trigger prerendering

name: Notebooks
description: Enables Notebooks.

name: Notification one-tap unsubscribe on Desktop
description: Enables an experimental UX  on Desktop that replaces the [Site settings]button on web push notifications with an [Unsubscribe] button.

name: NTP Alpha Background Collections
description: Shows alpha NTP background collections in Customize Chrome.

name: NTP Animated Doodles
description: Enables animated Doodles on the NTP.

name: NTP Background Image Error Detection
description: Checks NTP background image links for HTTP status errors.

name: NTP Calendar Module
description: Shows the Google Calendar module on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Component Extension
description: When enabled, registers the New Tab Page as a component extension.

name: NTP Composebox
description: Shows the Composebox on the New Tab Page Searchbox upon clicking the entrypoint.

name: NTP Customize Chrome Auto Promo
description: Shows the Customize Chrome on the New Tab Page automatically.

name: NTP Doodle Murals
description: Enables Doodle Murals on the NTP.

name: NTP Drive Module
description: Shows the Google Drive module on the New Tab Page

name: NTP Drive Module Segmentation
description: Uses segmentation data to decide whether to show the Drive module on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Dummy Modules
description: Adds dummy modules to New Tab Page when 'NTP Modules Redesigned' is enabled.

name: NTP Feature Optimization Module Removal
description: Enables auto-removal of stale modules from the NTP.

name: NTP Feature Optimization Shortcuts Removal
description: Enables auto-removal of stale shortcuts from the NTP.

name: NTP Footer
description: Adds footer to New Tab Page that encapsulates customize buttons and background/theme attributions.

name: NTP Microsoft Authentication Module
description: Shows the Microsoft Authentication Module on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Modules Sign-in Requirement
description: Makes NTP Sign-in Requirement per module, removing the requirement for Microsoft Modules

name: NTP Next Canvas Chip
description: Enables the Canvas tool chip for NTP action chips

name: NTP Next Features
description: Enables features (e.g., AI action chips) in NTP Next

name: NTP OneGoogleBar Async Bar Parts
description: Enables the OneGoogleBar async bar parts API on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Outlook Calendar Module
description: Shows the Outlook Calendar module on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Realbox Cycling Placeholders
description: Enables cycling placeholders within the Realbox 'Next' experience.

name: NTP Realbox Dynamic AI Mode Button
description: Enables dynamic behaviour for the AI mode button in the NTP Realbox.

name: NTP Realbox Next
description: Enables the Realbox 'Next' experience.

name: NTP Scaled Action Chips
description: Enables scaled merchandising action chips (e.g., dynamic tool suggestions and resource pickers) on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Scaled Action Chips Small
description: Enables small scaled merchandising action chips on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Searchbox (Realbox) Voice Search Coherence
description: Enables the voice search coherence experiment (new recording animation, new metrics, added stop/submit button) for the New Tab Page searchbox, with option for live transcription.

name: NTP Sharepoint Module
description: Shows the Sharepoint module on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Shortcuts Redesign
description: Enables the redesigned shortcuts on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Shortcuts Reorder
description: Enables shortcut reordering entrypoint on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Simplification Bookmark Bar
description: Auto-removes the bookmark bar on the New Tab Page and updates bookmark bar visbility settings.

name: NTP Starter Chip
description: Enables the starter chip on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Tab Groups Module
description: Shows the Tab Groups module on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Tab Groups Zero State Card
description: Enables the zero-state card for the Tab Groups Module on the New Tab Page.

name: NTP Threads Rail
description: Enables the Threads Rail on the NTP. The Hybrid variation renders the folded state natively in Chrome while the expanded state is rendered by Google Search.

name: NTP Wallpaper Search Button
description: Enables entry point on New Tab Page for Customize Chrome Side Panel Wallpaper Search.

name: NTP Wallpaper Search Button Animation
description: Enables animation for New Tab Page's Wallpaper Search button. Requires #ntp-wallpaper-search-button to be enabled too.

name: Omit TLS client certificates if credential mode disallows
description: Strictly conform the Fetch spec to omit TLS client certificates if credential mode disallows. Without this flag enabled, Chrome will always try sending client certificates regardless of the credential mode.

name: Omnibox AI Mode Space Does Not Activate
description: If enabled, pressing space when the AI mode button has focus will insert a space into the omnibox instead of activating the button.

name: Omnibox client prefetch Search
description: Allows omnibox to prefetch search suggestions provided by the Default Search Engine that the client thinks are likely to be navigated. Requires chrome://flags/#omnibox-search-prefetch

name: Omnibox Cross-Device Tab Zero Suggest
description: Enables showing cross-device tabs in the omnibox zero-state.

name: Omnibox Direct URL Input Prerendering
description: Enables Direct URL Input (DUI) prerendering in the Omnibox.

name: Omnibox Dynamic AI Mode Button
description: Enables dynamic behaviour for the AI mode button in the WebUI Omnibox.

name: Omnibox Dynamic Max Autocomplete
description: Configures the maximum number of autocomplete matches displayed in the Omnibox UI dynamically based on the number of URL matches.

name: Omnibox Everywhere Screenshot New Window
description: When enabled, submitting a query with a screenshot attached in Omnibox Everywhere fulfills the query in a new browser window aligned with the Omnibox Everywhere widget.

name: Omnibox Grouping Framework for Typed Suggestions
description: Enables an alternative grouping implementation for omnibox autocompletion.

name: Omnibox ML Scoring with Piecewise Score Mapping
description: Specifies how to blend URL ML scores and search traditional scores using a piecewise ML score mapping function.

name: Omnibox ML URL Score Caching
description: Enables in-memory caching of ML URL scores.

name: Omnibox ML URL Scoring
description: Enables ML-based relevance scoring for Omnibox URL Suggestions.

name: Omnibox ML URL Search Blending
description: Specifies how to blend URL ML scores and search traditional scores.

name: Omnibox on device head suggestions (incognito only)
description: Google head non personalized search suggestions provided by a compact on device model for incognito. Turn off this feature if you have other apps running which affects local file access (e.g. anti-virus software) and are experiencing searchbox typing lag.

name: Omnibox on device head suggestions (non-incognito only)
description: Google head non personalized search suggestions provided by a compact on device model for non-incognito. Turn off this feature if you have other apps running which affects local file access (e.g. anti-virus software) and are experiencing searchbox typing lag.

name: Omnibox on device tail suggestions
description: Google tail non personalized search suggestions provided by a compact on device model.

name: Omnibox on-focus suggestions on web and SRP
description: Enables zero-prefix suggestions on web and SRP when the omnibox is focused, subject to the same conditions and restrictions as on-clobber suggestions.

name: Omnibox prefetch Search
description: Allows omnibox to prefetch likely search suggestions provided by the Default Search Engine

name: Omnibox Rich Autocompletion Promising Combinations
description: Allow autocompletion for titles and non-prefixes. Suggestions whose titles or URLs contain the user input as a continuous chunk, but not necessarily a prefix, can be the default suggestion. Otherwise, only suggestions whose URLs are prefixed by the user input can be.

name: Omnibox UI Max Autocomplete Matches
description: Changes the maximum number of autocomplete matches displayed in the Omnibox UI.

name: Omnibox URL Scoring Model
description: Enables ML scoring model for Omnibox URL suggestions.

name: Omnibox Zero Prefix Suggest Prefetch Request Debouncing
description: Enables the use of a request debouncer to throttle the volume of ZPS prefetch requests issued to the remote Suggest service.

name: Omnibox Zero Prefix Suggestion Prefetching on SRP
description: Enables prefetching of the zero prefix suggestions for eligible users on the Search Results page.

name: Omnibox Zero Prefix Suggestion Prefetching on the Web
description: Enables prefetching of the zero prefix suggestions for eligible users on the Web (i.e. non-NTP and non-SRP URLs).

name: On-device category classifier
description: Enables the on-device category classifier.

name: On-Screen Only Accessibility Nodes
description: Enable experimental accessibility mode to improve performance which allows assistive technologies to access only accessibility nodes that are on-screen

name: OOPIF for PDF Viewer
description: Use an OOPIF for the PDF Viewer, instead of a GuestView.

name: Optimize WebRequest proxying
description: Enables optimization for WebRequest proxying by skipping unnecessary proxy evaluations when possible.

name: Organic repeatable queries in Most Visited tiles
description: Enables showing the most repeated queries, from the device browsing history, organically among the most visited sites in the MV tiles.

name: Organizer Panel
description: Enables the Organizer Panel.

name: Organizer Panel Foreign Tabs
description: Enables cross-device tabs in the Organizer Panel.

name: Origin-keyed Agent Clusters by default
description: Select the default behaviour for the Origin-Agent-Cluster http header. If enabled, an absent header will cause pages to be assigned to an origin-keyed agent cluster, and to a site-keyed agent cluster when disabled. Documents whose agent clusters are origin-keyed cannot set document.domain to relax the same-origin policy.

name: Origin-keyed Processes by default
description: Enables origin-keyed process isolation for most pages (i.e., those assigned to an origin-keyed agent cluster by default). This improves security but also increases the number of processes created. Note: enabling this feature also enables 'Origin-keyed Agent Clusters by default'.

name: Overlay Scrollbars
description: Override scrollbar mode to overlay or classic.

name: Override software rendering list
description: Overrides the built-in software rendering list and enables GPU-acceleration on unsupported system configurations.

name: Overscroll effect on non-root scrollers
description: Enables elastic overscroll effect on scrollers other than the root document (e.g. iframes and overflow areas).

name: Page Actions Elevated Toolbar
description: Enables the elevated capsule container for page action icons in the location bar.

name: Page Colors settings
